framework: Flask templates with vanilla HTML, CSS, GSAP and a static EdgeOne export
reference: direct public component-system mapping from https://www.butter.video/ without copying brand assets, copy, imagery or licensed font binaries
font_stack: Butter uses commercial Die Grotesk and ABC Diatype; ViralX uses OFL Hanken Grotesk plus Noto Sans SC
palette: observed Butter values #EDEDED page, #FAFAFA floating surfaces, #0F0F0F/#1E1E1E ink and editor, #4DC5E5 signal with restrained #F9ABFF, #E9D352 and #63AD45 punctuation
motion: GSAP entrance, visible-by-default one-time scroll translation, real streamed progress and reduced-motion fallback
spacing: shared named four-point scale with Butter-like detached navigation, centred marquee and wide chapter intervals

validation.playwright: desktop, 320px, 375px, 390px, 414px, 768px, 1280x800, 1920px, settings, reduced motion and EdgeOne static boundary passed
validation.slop_audit: passed after lifting ad hoc colours into tokens, moving the desktop object into the fold, flattening settings headings and shortening mobile summary copy
validation.runtime_boundary: EdgeOne is static presentation; Flask remains the full local product
